text:
maria.devex: quick question — noticed sample-apps + CLI + SDKs use different env var names for auth and it confuses new users. CLI expects REDWOOD_TOKEN, python sdk checks REDWOOD_API_KEY, js sdk accepts REDWOOD_KEY. can we pick one and document precedence?

kevin.sdk: ugh yeah. we started with historical names. not great. do we want a single canonical var or an ordered fallback?

jess.security: single canonical is better for security reviews. recommendation from compliance: use REDWOOD_API_KEY and discourage aliases. rotation tooling should update all aliases though.

arun.sre: from infra side, fallback chain is helpful for backwards compat in infra automation. something like: (1) explicit param in client constructor, (2) REDWOOD_API_KEY, (3) REDWOOD_TOKEN (legacy), (4) ~/.redwood/credentials, (5) metadata service.

maria.devex: +1 on explicit param > env > file > metadata. but let's make names consistent across SDKs and CLI. also need clear behavior for org/project scoping: env vs config file vs token-scoped project.

kevin.sdk: proposed minimal change: standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_ORG / REDWOOD_PROJECT for scoping. SDKs should accept aliases for one major release and log a deprecation warning. CLI should start writing REDWOOD_API_KEY into .env templates.

jess.security: agree. rotation story: tokens should be refreshable when using short-lived creds. if REDWOOD_API_KEY is long-lived, support rotate endpoint + client-side retry on 401 with one attempt after reloading creds. document that SDKs do one immediate retry only.

arun.sre: note about retries: avoid thundering herd on rotation. add jitter/backoff and a configurable retry hook so apps can implement custom refresh semantics.

maria.devex: sample app change list I suggest: update .env.example to use REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT, add readme section "credential precedence", include small code snippet for recommended client constructor.

kevin.sdk: code snippet for fallback we can include in all SDK READMEs:

```
// pseudo-js fallback order inside SDK initialization
const apiKey = options.apiKey || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN || readCredsFromFile();
const org = options.org || process.env.REDWOOD_ORG || readDefaultOrgFromConfig();
client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey, org });
```

maria.devex: perfect. can we also add a tiny migration script in devex repo to auto-rename REDWOOD_TOKEN -> REDWOOD_API_KEY in local .env files for devs?

jess.security: ok but make script opt-in and print risk warnings. rotation-bot should also post a reminder for teams holding long-lived tokens.

rotations-bot: reminder scheduled: audit tokens older than 90 days next-week. :rotating_light:

kevin.sdk: I'll open a PR to standardize env var names in node + python SDKs and add deprecation warnings for one major release. assigning to myself.

maria.devex: thanks! i'll update sample apps and onboarding checklist, and ping docs to add migration guide.

arun.sre: I'll draft a runbook for rotation + recommended retry policy for the platform pages.

maria.devex: awesome, moving this to action items in the devex board. small followup: can we ensure SDKs expose a hook for "onAuthFailure" so apps can plug in secret rotation?

kevin.sdk: yes, will include onAuthFailure(callback) in the PR.

maria.devex: cool, closing thread for now — will reopen if blockers show up. :thumbsup:
